Questions

Frequently asked questions.

What is the difference between LocalLift Signature and working with The SocialDM directly?

LocalLift Signature is our done for you weekly posting plan for individual agents, at $199 a month with no contract. Teams and brokerages work with The SocialDM directly on a custom plan that covers social, Google and AI visibility across every agent.

Do you work with individual agents, teams and brokerages?

Yes. Individual agents usually start with LocalLift Signature. Teams and brokerages get a plan scoped to the number of agents and markets.

Do you work with title reps?

Yes. LocalLift Signature works for title reps as well as agents.

Will you post as me?

With LocalLift Signature, posts are prepared for your market and scheduled for you, and you can reply any time if something looks off. Team and brokerage plans include an approval step for every agent and the brand.

Do you run paid ads?

When they fit the plan. Many agents get more from a strong profile, steady reviews and useful local content before spending on ads.
